name: Selling Fish
summary: Dockmaster Baren needs spotted sunfish from Lake Everstill. The fish feed Lakeshire, but murlocs along the shore make them dangerous to gather.

sections.title: A Staple of Lake Everstill
sections.body: Spotted sunfish are prized around Lake Everstill, and townspeople and passing merchants keep demand high. Yet Lakeshire's supplies often run thin, though the fish swim below the surface. Local threats stretch the town's strength, so even basic trade depends on travelers.

sections.title: Trouble on the Shallows
sections.body: Anglers nearby could once fill Dockmaster Baren's orders with ease. Now aggressive murloc tribes haunt the shallows and banks, keeping ordinary townsfolk from the water. You can fish while watching for danger, or take sunfish from the foraging murlocs that trouble the shore.

faq.answer: Dockmaster Baren oversees the docks and boat traffic on Lake Everstill in Lakeshire. He manages the town's water trade and relies on capable travelers to bring in fresh fish and face threats around the lake.

faq.q: Why are spotted sunfish in such high demand?
faq.answer: Spotted sunfish are famed around Lake Everstill, making them a Lakeshire staple and an important trade good. The town's stocks run low because ordinary anglers cannot fish safely while hostile creatures trouble the lake.

faq.q: How do murlocs end up with the sunfish?
faq.answer: Murloc tribes along Lake Everstill forage and hunt in the shallows. They kill or drive away local fishermen, then gather fish for their camps, where travelers can take the catch instead of fishing for it.

faq.q: Where can spotted sunfish be found?
faq.answer: Spotted sunfish live in Lake Everstill in Redridge Mountains. You can catch them with a fishing rod or take them from murlocs along the banks and shallows.

faq.q: How does this quest fit with Murloc Poachers?
faq.answer: Dockmaster Baren offers help against the murloc poachers while seeking sunfish. Since murlocs prowl the lake and take its fish, dealing with them can also recover the catch they have gathered.

faq.q: Is fishing required to help Dockmaster Baren?
aliases: can i do this without fishing pole
faq.answer: You need no fishing gear or skill to help Dockmaster Baren. You can angle for sunfish, or take the fish by force from the murloc tribes that hunt the lake, as Baren openly suggests.

angles.text: As a cook, you can look to Lakeshire's waters for spotted sunfish, a freshwater delicacy prized in town.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help sustain Redridge's food supply, since the Kingdom of Stormwind offers little military aid to the region.
